author: Forbes
description:
Nvidia is opening an independent investigation into whether its own billionaire CEO Jensen Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company said in a statement on Sunday, after Huang told employees at the company he had an affair.

author: Forbes
description:
How did a working-class kid from Liverpool overcome one of the most restrictive record contracts in music history to build a multi-billion-dollar empire?

In this premiere episode of The Billie, we explore how Sir Paul McCartney navigated the chaos of Beatlemania, broke free from predatory industry contracts, and quietly amassed one of the most lucrative music publishing portfolios in the world—from Buddy Holly’s catalog to classic Broadway hits like Guys and Dolls.

Discover the legal wars, catalog buybacks, and business instincts that transformed a songwriting legend into a self-made billionaire.
